# Affine.Earth

> Sovereign observer-independent integer and exact-rational compute substrate (`M8 = S4 x C4`, `vQbit` Pythagorean unit rotor `(221/229, 60/229)`, affine shear conservation `y - tau == Ax`, Born residual `0`, gate execution `34` Flicks = `21250/441 ns` at `705,600,000` Hz, `0` W GPU, `0` IEEE-754 floats).
